about.description: Single-stock perpetual market tracking NAVER Corporation (NAVER) on Paragon. Users get linear exposure to NAVER share-price moves without owning NAVER shares, shareholder rights, or dividend claims. HIP-3 builder-deployed market on Hyperliquid in the para namespace, cash-settled in USDC. Equity marks are sourced from Pyth equity feeds during covered sessions and bounded internally off-hours. Market is flagged isDelisted by the Hyperliquid API as of 2026-08-14, with zero open interest and zero 24h volume, and it no longer appears in Paragon's published equities table.
